result.title: Analysis result
result.partialNotice: Some sections aren't available in this result.
result.unsupported: This result was produced in a format this page doesn't support yet.
result.unsupportedHint: Nothing was interpreted. You can go back to your history.
result.outOfRange: Value outside the expected range for this unit.
result.noIndicators: No supported indicator in this result.

useful_outcome_rate.label: Useful outcome rate
useful_outcome_rate.description: Share of analyzed conversations with a useful outcome, as declared by the domain.

outcome_field_coverage_rate.label: Outcome field coverage
outcome_field_coverage_rate.description: Share of records that carried an outcome field at all. Low coverage limits every outcome-based number below.

conversion_rate.label: Conversion rate
conversion_rate.description: Share of analyzed conversations that reached the conversion status declared by the domain.

intent_coverage_rate.label: Intent coverage
intent_coverage_rate.description: Share of the intent catalog observed in this dataset.

analyzed_conversation_count.label: Analyzed conversations
analyzed_conversation_count.description: How many conversations entered the analysis. It is the denominator of the rates above.

useful_outcome_count.label: Useful outcomes
useful_outcome_count.description: How many conversations had a useful outcome. Absolute count, never a percentage.

handoff_count.label: Handoffs
handoff_count.description: How many conversations were handed off, as observed in the records.

conversion_count.label: Conversions
conversion_count.description: How many conversations reached the conversion status. Absolute count.

total_estimated_cost.label: Total estimated cost
total_estimated_cost.description: Sum of the per-record cost estimates provided by the source. It is an estimate, not billing.

token_cost_total.label: Token cost
token_cost_total.description: Portion of the estimated cost attributed to tokens.

handoff_cost_total.label: Handoff cost
handoff_cost_total.description: Portion of the estimated cost attributed to handoffs.

cost_per_useful_outcome.label: Cost per useful outcome
cost_per_useful_outcome.description: Estimated cost divided by useful outcomes. With no useful outcome there is no denominator — the value is absent, not zero.

cost_per_session.label: Cost per session
cost_per_session.description: Estimated cost divided by analyzed conversations.

mean_response_variance_per_intent.label: Mean response variance per intent
mean_response_variance_per_intent.description: Average variance of responses within each intent. It measures dispersion — it is not consistency, drift or confidence.

result.partiallyMeasured: Measured on part of the sample
result.unsupportedIndicators: Indicators received but not recognized by this interface

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Produced by the analytics component over the same dataset.
analytics.partialNotice: Part of the analytics output was omitted to avoid revealing small groups. What is shown is complete and was not recalculated.
analytics.withheldBody: The analysis finished. Nothing from the analytics component could be released without risking the identification of small groups.
analytics.withheldHint: This is a privacy decision, not a failure. The engine indicators above are unaffected.
analytics.suppressedStats: Statistics were withheld: too few records for them to be published without identifying someone.
analytics.otherWithheld: Labels below the floor were not grouped either — their total is also too small to publish.
analytics.minGroupSize: Labels are published only from {{n}} records upwards.
analytics.highCardinality: Too many distinct labels to publish them: this is a decision, not missing data.
analytics.coarsened: Value ranges were widened so each one stays above the floor.
analytics.precisionBounded: Bounds, not a point value: the cut fell inside a widened range.
analytics.seriesSuppressed: The series was not published: no granularity kept every window above the floor.
analytics.coarsenedSeries: Granularity was widened so each window stays above the floor.
analytics.blocksNotPresented: This result carries {{n}} analytics block(s) that this page does not display yet.
analytics.measuresNotSummarized: {{n}} declared measure(s) could not be summarized.
analytics.measuresNotAuthorized: {{n}} measure(s) were not authorized for publication.
analytics.unreadableBlocks: {{n}} block(s) did not match the contract and were not interpreted.
analytics.liveSubtitle: Read from the analytics component, independently of the result document.
analytics.noReadable: No readable block in this projection.
analytics.waitingDocument: The result document is not available yet. What follows was read from the analytics component.

state.partial: Delivered in part. What is missing was not measured — it is not zero.
state.failed: The analytics component failed. The rest of this page is unaffected.
state.unknown: State unknown. Nothing is being asserted about the analytics component.

analytics.exportReadyHint: Produced by the analysis, not by this screen.

exportState.expired: The package is no longer available for download.
exportState.failed: The package could not be produced.

result.attentionNone: Nothing in this result was flagged by the analysis.

landing.heroTitle: Your AI rarely breaks in a single moment.
landing.heroBody: Sentinela surfaces inconsistency, behavioral drift, token waste, and structural instability before they become user-visible failures, support noise, or operational cost.
landing.heroProofTitle: See value before you prepare a dataset.
landing.heroProofBody: Try a sample analysis to see the exact diagnosis, alerts, and recommended fixes you will get from a real run.
landing.heroUploadBody: Start with exported JSON and get a first diagnostic in minutes.
landing.heroConnectBody: Move from one-off analysis to repeatable monitoring when your stack is ready.
landing.problemBody: Sentinela exists for the gap between raw logs and real governance: the place where drift, inconsistency, and waste accumulate before they show up as obvious incidents.
landing.problemClosing: Sentinela helps teams answer a harder question than "is the system up?": "is the model still behaving the way we need it to?".
landing.problem1Body: Long, repetitive, or unfocused responses inflate token spend without improving task completion.
landing.problem2Title: Logs alone do not reveal semantic drift
landing.problem2Body: A model can look healthy in throughput dashboards while quietly changing tone, structure, or quality.
landing.problem3Title: Inconsistency becomes user-visible before teams notice
landing.problem3Body: What starts as subtle variance eventually turns into support friction, trust erosion, and brand instability.
landing.problem4Title: Manual QA does not scale with production volume
landing.problem4Body: Sampling conversations by hand is slow, expensive, and too shallow to detect systemic behavior changes.
landing.metricsTitle: From raw conversations to operational signal.
landing.metricsBody: Sentinela turns conversation history into measurable indicators your team can act on: instability, wasted spend, overlap, drift, and emerging risk.
landing.workflowBody: Designed to make model behavior legible without forcing your team into another complex observability rollout.
landing.workflowStep1Body: Start with exported JSON or pipeline output. No heavyweight setup is required to run a first analysis.
landing.workflowStep2Body: Sentinela evaluates consistency, drift, overlap, structure, and efficiency across intents and repeated situations.
landing.workflowStep3Body: Get an executive-readable diagnostic with risk signals your team can compare, monitor, and improve over time.
landing.securityTitle: Security and trust matter as much as detection
landing.securityBody: Observability for AI only works when teams can evaluate behavior with discipline around privacy, access, and how sensitive data is handled.
landing.security1Body: The analysis flow is designed to limit unnecessary retention and keep handling scoped to what the diagnostic needs.
landing.security2Body: Built for teams that need visibility into model behavior without treating conversation data casually.
landing.security3Body: Authentication, environment separation, and protected application areas help keep analysis access controlled.
landing.security4Body: Sentinela is being shaped for organizations that need governance discipline, not just a prettier dashboard.
landing.pricingBody: Start with analysis, then grow into repeatable governance when the operational need is clear.
landing.footerTitle: Stop treating production AI like a black box.
landing.footerBody: Start with a free analysis, see where behavior is drifting, and give your team a more precise way to govern quality, consistency, and cost.
landing.footerLegal: © 2026 Sentinela. AI observability for production teams. Powered by Baluarte. All rights reserved.

problem.h2: What you can't see is what hurts
problem.body: AI teams without observability fly blind — and pay the price in undetected degradation, inflated cost, and lost trust.

p1.title: Quality degrades silently
p1.desc: Your model responds, but answers gradually worsen between runs. Without observability, you find out from user feedback — too late.

p2.title: Token waste is invisible
p2.desc: 40% of token spend goes to verbosity, repetition, and low-value responses. Costs rise before anyone notices the pattern.

p3.title: Decisions lack evidence
p3.desc: You know something's wrong but don't know what, or where to act first. Intuition isn't operability.

platform.h2: Six signals that turn AI behavior
platform.body: Sentinela analyzes conversations and produces indicators your team can act on — not just monitor.

c1.title: Behavior Scoring
c1.desc: Composite score of response quality across multiple axes: consistency, completeness, format adherence, and behavioral drift.

c2.title: Drift Detection
c2.desc: Detects structural deviation from expected baseline, run by run, before it becomes a visible problem.

c3.title: Cost per Useful Outcome
c3.desc: Calculates the real cost per valuable response — separating useful tokens from verbosity and structural waste.

c4.title: Intent Clustering
c4.desc: Automatically maps intent patterns and detects when distinct clusters start producing overlapping outputs.

c5.title: Behavioral Volatility
c5.desc: Measures oscillations between similar sessions in tone, length, and structure — and flags emerging instability.

c6.title: Actionable Recommendations
c6.desc: Prioritizes findings by impact and delivers structured recommendations. Not a dashboard to interpret — a decision ready to execute.

how.h2: From raw data to decision in minutes.
how.body: Zero infrastructure setup. Zero code integration. Upload, analyze, act.

s1.title: Export and upload
s1.desc: Export your AI conversation history as JSON or JSONL. Zero code integration. Zero SDK.
s1.detail: Supports Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, LangChain, custom APIs

s2.title: The engine analyzes
s2.desc: The engine scores consistency, detects drift, maps intents, estimates cost-per-outcome, and exposes patterns in seconds.

s3.title: Act with evidence
s3.desc: Your dashboard shows what's degrading, what it costs, and which action will have the most operational impact.
